hero.title:
I design and build software 
 for work that happens on site
hero.description: Product builder for construction, manufacturing and energy. I take products from the first conversation on site to the code that runs in production.
hero.trusted: Clients and teams I've worked with

columns.headline: Construction management system, from tender to warranty
columns.description: I designed and built an office panel and a mobile app for site crews: cost estimate, subcontractor quotes, tasks and progress reports in one chain. It runs a live contract in Krakow: 198 tasks, 360 cost items, and 1,565 site photos uploaded by the crew during one survey task.

columns.headline: Why fuel gets more expensive, explained on one map
columns.description: An interactive map of global oil flows and the straits they pass through, ending with the price of a litre of fuel in each EU country. Built on UN Comtrade, JODI and EU data, refreshed automatically every day, in five languages.

columns.headline: Energy data platform for real estate
columns.description: Two web platforms and a mobile app for smart metering: portfolio reporting and decarbonisation for property companies, a consumption portal for tenants, and a field app for device installers.

columns.headline: Scheduling app for personal trainers, from interviews to paid licences
columns.description: I spotted the problem at my own gym, ran 16 interviews with trainers and built a team of seven around it. The first version made scheduling slower, so I rebuilt it around automation and mapped the scheduling algorithm in diagrams to fix 30–45 second recalculations. Pre-sales turned into paying customers.
